title: Alhucemas landing
text: The Alhucemas landing was a military amphibious landing which took place on 8 September 1925 at Alhucemas by the Spanish Army and Navy and by an allied French naval and aerial contingent, that would put an end to the Rif War. It is considered the first amphibious landing in history involving the use of tanks and massive seaborne air support. Alhucemas is seen as a precursor of the Allied amphibious landings in World War II, and the first successful combined operation of the 20th century.
